item.title: Interfering in the USP25-SIRT1 Interaction Reduces the Onset of Cellular Senescence
item.description: Researchers here report on the development a senostatic treatment, one that reduces the pace at which cells become senescent in aged tissues. item.title: The Gut Microbiome in Aging
